fields.statement: Verifier at eb83f6d89: ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestModelBranch -v; all five subtests PASS against a local bare origin and a fake gh. AcceptShipsBranch: accept pushes one model/<cs8>-<entry8> branch whose diff from origin/main is exactly one .rhiza/log entry, one pr create, temp worktree removed, entry also in the main checkout; a second write extends the same branch with no second PR. RecordApplyCarriesRender: a --record apply's branch carries .rhiza/rendered/ and rhiza check in a worktree of it reports no stale render. FailingGHWarns: write succeeds with a warning and no worktree left. DryRunPushesNothing: no branch, no gh call. NoOriginStaysLocal: no gh call. Adjacent ship/mirror tests also pass; go vet and gofmt clean. Read the diff (model_branch.go, workspace.go writeEntry hook, RHIZA_TEST_NOW gate wired through cmd/rhiza Getenv). The package run's trailing FAIL (.rhiza-root/usage.live.json changed) is the live root daemon rewriting that file every few seconds with no tests running, not this change.
